title: docs(service-messaging): name the sys_webhook edit check behind the redeliver door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D9b2XhMFsspWMmP1eQ3G4mk)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyh2cxBQ2LKn2VVfxq

Fixes #27706

## What changes

Comments only, in `packages/services/service-messaging`:

- `src/http-outbox.ts`, doc comment of `assertHttpRedeliverable` ("Why this is a security refusal and not a tidiness one"): the sentence "`POST /api/v1/webhooks/redeliver` is reachable by any authenticated user" and the "that user" clause after it now name the current check: edit (`update`) access to `sys_webhook`, as decided by `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/redeliver-entitlement.ts`. The refusal's own reason (a parked row carries no signature) is unchanged.
- `src/http-outbox-parked-record.integration.test.ts`, header comment: the same clause ("which any authenticated user can reach") is corrected the same way.

No code and no assertion changed.

## Why

After #27474 the redeliver door admits only a caller with edit access to `sys_webhook`. A security doc comment that names the wrong check misleads the next person deciding what the door allows.

## Verification

- `git diff origin/main`: 2 files, +7 / -3, all inside comment blocks.
- All 53 gate families derived by `dispatch-gates --commands` plus `pnpm lint` were run. 46 exit 0, plus `pnpm lint`.
- `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` and `check:query-options-erasure` went red on the first pass only because the gitignored, generated `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` did not yet exist in the fresh worktree. Re-run after it was generated: both exit 0.
- Exit 3 (prerequisite not met, needs a whole-tree build), NOT MEASURED locally: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. A comment-only diff cannot move them; CI measures them.
- `check:commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`: pass.

Out of scope, reported and not edited: `src/messaging-service.ts:389-391` (the `redeliver` doc comment, #10740 paragraph) still says the door "is open to any authenticated user". The package `CHANGELOG.md` has the same historical phrase, which is a release record and is not hand-edited.

No changeset: comments only (`skip-changeset` requested from the seat).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：webhook 重投递入口的两处代码注释，改为写明现行权限（对 sys_webhook 有编辑权）。
- 为什么改：#27474 后权限已收紧，注释还写着"任何登录用户可达"，会误导后来判断安全面的人。
- 风险与回滚：只改注释，无行为变化；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：http-outbox.ts 中 assertHttpRedeliverable 的注释段。
- 两分钟验证：看 diff，只有注释行变动。
- 需要你做的：无。
